speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having sudden onset abdominal pain; could you please describe exactly where the pain is located and what it feels like?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis.

I have noted your recent myocardial infarction and the bloody loose stools; to confirm the diagnosis, I will request the results of a complete blood count (CBC) and a lactate level.
